corrections.was: A table steps the machine with scripted input. A Condition is a test on a parameter that must hold before a transition may fire. Here the tests look at whether the robot is on the floor, and at its vertical speed. Leave the floor rising, and jump fires. Start falling, and fall fires. On the last tick nothing is true, so it stays in ground. For example, fall to ground fires only while a script's true or false value named landed is true.
corrections.now: A table steps the machine with scripted input. A Condition is a test on a parameter that must hold before a transition may fire. Here the tests are expressions that check whether the robot is on the floor, and its vertical speed. Leave the floor rising, and jump fires. Start falling, and fall fires. On the last tick nothing is true, so it stays in ground. For example, fall to ground fires only while a true or false parameter named landed is true.
corrections.why: Chapter 11 drives the robot's transitions with advance_expression (is_on_floor(), velocity.y), not with advance_condition, which 'becomes a boolean parameter you set from code'; the floor and speed tests are now called expressions, and the example now uses a true or false parameter on the tree, matching 'a test on a parameter'.

corrections.was: A grid of pass and fail, by landing tick. A Mutation check means putting the old broken version back and running the new test, which must fail. On the fixed scene the state test passes at both landings. On the pre-fix scene it fails at the first-tick landing and passes at the second, so a test run at one landing could pass by luck. For example, after fixing a coin that counted twice, restore the old coin script and confirm the new test fails.
corrections.now: A grid of pass and fail, by landing tick. A Mutation check means putting the old broken version back and running the new test, which must fail. In this simulated grid, the fixed scene passes both. On the pre-fix scene the test fails at the first-tick landing only, so one landing could pass by luck. The real check, over three hops, failed at both. For example, after fixing a coin that counted twice, restore the old coin script and confirm the new test fails.
corrections.why: The grid is computed from the single-landing sampling simulation (slide note); Chapter 11's real mutation check failed 2a and 2b at both offsets over three hops, so the narration now marks the grid as simulated and states the real result.

corrections.was: Two boxes inside one Unreal asset. An Animation Blueprint is the Unreal asset that holds an animation state machine and its logic. Its event graph writes variables from gameplay, here Speed and Is Falling. Its anim graph uses them to choose a state and to blend. For example, the event graph copies a character's speed from its movement on each update, and the anim graph uses that number to pick Run.
